evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Verify authenticated GitHub remote MCP compatibility independently of agent claims.
intent.acceptance: A protected raw-canary step, bound to its immutable executed workflow, completes initialize, initialized notification, ping, nonempty tool discovery including list_issues and a non-error list_issues JSON-RPC response.

evidence.opportunity: Three fixed pre-cutoff raw-canary attempts, not the lifetime run population
filters: Original GitHub run, attempt jobs, exact-head editable and compiled workflow and protected raw-job log must be present and digest-verified.
The executed editable raw-canary script must exactly match the frozen revision's script, including official fixed endpoint, read-only header and repository-scoped list_issues payload.
The compiled workflow must contain that same script in the separate raw_mcp_canary job.
The uniquely matched completed raw step must contain actual runtime output in order, excluding printed shell source, ANSI-colored command echoes and unrelated job sections.
Initialize, initialized notification, ping, nonempty tool catalog including list_issues, list_issues non-error response and terminal handshake success must all be witnessed.
Reported protocol and tool count must be concrete; conflicting or malformed witnesses do not qualify.
Seven-day reporting is an explicit retrospective presentation choice, not a claim of ex-ante cadence or exhaustive weekly test coverage.
evidence.collection: Offline original GitHub responses: public repository identity, exact run/attempt/jobs, executed source/compiled scripts and protected raw-step runtime witnesses.

model.architecture: One frozen source-defined transport predicate; acquisition is separate from model-free native verification and scoring.
model.recommendation: Not rated; no keep threshold, monetary value or workflow repair attribution.

presentation.label: Verified raw MCP transport checks
presentation.betterLabel: More independently verified sampled compatibility checks

metrics.name: Verified raw MCP transport checks
metrics.formula: Count distinct assessed run-attempt identities whose source-bound protected raw step independently witnesses the complete frozen transport predicate; null without an assessed selected cohort.

explanation: This proves the source-defined raw transport check, not agent-usable MCP, exact returned issue content, a complete JSON-RPC conformance matrix or full workflow goal.
The source canary does not validate returned issue schema or exact issue bytes. Its success cannot be promoted to independent issue-content readback.
Sampled executions are repeated capability availability checks, not fresh defect repairs or a lifetime exhaustive test population.
Missing originals and all unassessed periods remain null, not zero or failed authentication.
No keep threshold, cost, exclusive causation or workflow contribution is inferred.
limitations.authentication: The executed source permits secret-token fallbacks before GITHUB_TOKEN. Masked logs do not identify the credential class.
